title: tc-audience-mix
description:
Who is reading – a sector mix as bars, an internal-versus-external split and the top places, each with its share,
and a readout of the row under the pointer or focus.

sectors.description: Readers by sector, in the order given

split.description: Readers inside and outside the organisation; null hides the split

places.description: Readers by place, largest first as given; put "Other" last yourself

splitLabel.description: The heading of the internal-versus-external split

internalLabel.description: The name of the internal share in the split

externalLabel.description: The name of the external share in the split

unit.description: What the shares are of, for the readout: "54% of readers"

embedded.description: No card or header – for use inside another component

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

value.description: A count or a share in any unit; the percentage comes from the group's total
